stops.text: Young skin. Even surface, no lines at rest.
Skin in its thirties. The first lines show only in expression.
Skin in its fifties. Settled lines around the eyes and mouth, looser at the jaw.
Long weathered skin. Deep lines, sun and wind in the surface, the texture of a life outdoors.
Clear skin, drawn simply.
A few marks: a spot or two, faint freckles, an old scar.
Visible texture: pores, blemishes, uneven colour, a healed scar or two.
Everything the skin has been through is visible, drawn without judgement.
Clean shaven.
Stubble, a few days old.
A short beard, close to the jaw.
A full beard reaching the collarbone.
A long beard well past the chest.
Shaved to the scalp.
A short crop.
Hair to the jaw.
Hair past the shoulders.
Hair to the waist.
Proportions stay true. The drawing is stylised, the face is not exaggerated.
Gentle exaggeration. The features that identify them are a little stronger.
Clear caricature. Distinctive features pushed, the rest simplified.
Full caricature. Two or three features carry the whole likeness.
A still face. Whatever they feel stays behind the eyes.
A readable expression, held lightly.
A strong expression involving the whole face.
The expression is the picture. Everything else supports it.
A plain background in one colour or tone.
A suggestion of a place: two or three shapes, nothing detailed.
A readable setting behind them, still clearly secondary to the face.
A full scene, with the person placed in it rather than in front of it.
Everything is equally sharp, front to back.
The background softens a little behind the shoulders.
The background falls away into soft shapes. The face stays sharp.
Only the eyes and the near side of the face are sharp. Everything else dissolves.
Hard light. Edges of shadow are crisp, contrast is high.
Directional light with a defined but not sharp shadow edge.
Soft light wrapping the face, shadows fading gradually.
Enveloping light with almost no visible shadow edge.
Nearly colourless. A restricted palette close to grey.
Muted colour, nothing pure.
Full colour, still matte and hand made.
Saturated colour, pushed to the edge of the palette.
Clothes and objects look new and well kept.
Everything shows ordinary use.
Clothes are softened, seams shine, objects are scuffed and mended.
Everything is worn nearly through, repaired more than once, and kept anyway.
No jewellery at all.
One or two small pieces, worn every day.
Several pieces that plainly belong together.
Heavily adorned, and every piece looks earned rather than bought.
